item.dedsafio-4-mechanics.dedita_roja.to: Worth 100 green deditas or 10,000 blue deditas.
item.dedsafio-4-mechanics.dedita_rosa.to: Daily mission voucher: deliver it at the mountain to claim your reward.
item.dedsafio-4-mechanics.totem_eon.tool: Automatically saves you from lethal damage.
Keep it in your inventory or either hand.
Saves you like a regular totem and grants its effects.
item.dedsafio-4-mechanics.totem_flor.too: The Globanoid Totem prevents one death.
Keep it in your inventory or either hand.
On activation, grants Resistance V for 1 second to protect you from rapid hits.
item.dedsafio-4-mechanics.totem_golem.to: Gain extra health while carrying it.
Keep it in your inventory or either hand.
Increases your maximum health by 2 hearts.
If it saves you from death, it is consumed and the bonus is lost.
Consumable · restores your health to full.
Hold use to eat it; the effect applies after the eating finishes.
Restores all health and keeps the Golem Totem bonus if you are holding one.
item.dedsafio-4-mechanics.bolsa_primitiv: Use the bag to open it and store items.
Its contents stay saved when you close the screen or leave the world.
item.dedsafio-4-mechanics.ender_bag.tool: Access your Ender storage from anywhere.
Use it to open your Ender inventory.
Shares contents with all of your Ender Chests.
item.dedsafio-4-mechanics.corazon_rojo.t: Consumable · adds one heart to your maximum health.
Hold use to eat it; the extra heart is added when eating finishes.
Each red heart consumed increases maximum health by 1 heart.
You lose all extra red hearts when you die.
item.dedsafio-4-mechanics.corazon_dorado: Hold use to eat it; the effect applies after the eating finishes.
Grants a full bar: 10 absorption hearts.
Absorption is temporary and is lost when it expires or takes damage.
